hunks.baseline: The boy who had wandered from place to place, begging for food, met a master one day and became the eighteenth successor of the Fire Gate Clan. When time passed and his master returned to the earth, he became both the clan’s sole Disciple and its Sect Leader.
hunks.sol: The boy who had wandered the streets begging for food met a master one day and became the eighteenth successor of the Fire Gate Clan. Years later, when his master returned to the earth, he became the clan’s sole Disciple and Sect Leader.

hunks.baseline: It had taken a truly long time for the boy to become a young man, the young man to become middle-aged, and finally the middle-aged man to become old.
hunks.sol: The boy became a young man, the young man reached middle age, and the middle-aged man finally grew old. It had been a long, long journey.

hunks.baseline: During that time, a great war erupted—one that would determine the fate of the world—and a new nation was founded under a new imperial surname.
hunks.sol: In that time, a great war erupted that would determine the fate of the world. A new nation arose, and even the surname of the Son of Heaven changed.

hunks.baseline: Five floods and earthquakes struck. Plagues spread, and bands of bandits wearing red turbans rose everywhere, pillaging as they pleased.
hunks.sol: Five floods and earthquakes struck. Plagues spread, and bands of Red Turbans rose throughout the land, pillaging wherever they went.

hunks.baseline: In every event Jeok Cheongang had witnessed, there had been disasters brought about by humans and divine punishments sent down by the heavens.
hunks.sol: Among everything Jeok Cheongang had witnessed, there had been disasters wrought by human hands and divine punishments sent down by the heavens.

hunks.baseline: But one event had left the deepest and greatest mark on his life.
hunks.sol: But one event had left a deeper, greater mark on his life than any other.

hunks.baseline: An age when corpses formed mountains and blood flowed like rivers.
hunks.sol: An age when corpses formed mountains and blood flowed in rivers.

hunks.baseline: Amid that war’s vortex, Jeok Cheongang glimpsed a vast world of demonic, heterodox arts unlike anything he had ever experienced.
hunks.sol: Amid the maelstrom of that war, Jeok Cheongang had glimpsed a vast world of demonic, heterodox arts unlike anything he had ever known.

hunks.baseline: The martial arts of the Heavenly Demon Divine Cult, which could be compared to those of Shaolin Temple, the Mount Tai and Northern Dipper of the Murim’s orthodox faction, were deep and broad—devious, yet bizarre.
hunks.sol: The Demonic Path martial arts of the Heavenly Demon Divine Cult rivaled those of Shaolin Temple—the Mount Tai and Northern Dipper of the Murim’s orthodox faction—in depth and breadth. They were sinister and bizarre.

hunks.baseline: Even if he combined everything he had seen and experienced throughout his life, it would amount to nothing more than a drop in the bucket compared to the scene unfolding before his eyes.
hunks.sol: Even everything he had seen and experienced throughout his long life amounted to no more than a drop in the bucket compared to the scene unfolding before his eyes.

hunks.baseline: And when he finally saw the enormous being reveal itself, Jeok Cheongang felt as though every drop of blood in his body had frozen.
hunks.sol: The moment that enormous being finally revealed itself, Jeok Cheongang felt the blood freeze in his veins.

hunks.baseline: Given the years he had lived and the position he held, he had seen no small number of beings that ordinary martial artists might never encounter even once in their entire lives—beings known as spirit beasts or evil beasts.
hunks.sol: Given his age and standing, he had seen no small number of spiritual creatures and evil beasts that ordinary martial artists might never encounter even once in their lives.

hunks.baseline: It was different. It surpassed every bit of Fire King Jeok Cheongang’s experience and knowledge.
hunks.sol: It was different. It surpassed every scrap of experience and knowledge Fire King Jeok Cheongang possessed.

hunks.baseline: The thing being destroyed by the monster was not merely the cliff.
hunks.sol: The monster was not merely destroying the cliff.

hunks.baseline: The laws and rules of the world he had firmly believed in were collapsing along with the bizarre boulders. They were being destroyed and scattered completely.
hunks.sol: The laws and order of the world he had always believed in were crumbling along with the jagged boulders, shattered and scattered beyond recognition.

hunks.baseline: And Jeok Cheongang was not the only one feeling that shock.
hunks.sol: And Jeok Cheongang was not alone in his shock.

hunks.baseline: “Ah, ahhh!”

The greatest assassin of all time, known as the Slaughter Saint, could not suppress his groan of disbelief. Crouching Dragon Guest Zhuge Feng, whose knowledge and genius alone were said to rival those of Zhuge Wuhou of the past, was left speechless.
hunks.sol: The greatest assassin of all time, known as the Slaughter Saint, could not suppress his astonished sigh. Crouching Dragon Guest Zhuge Feng, whose knowledge and genius were said to rival those of Zhuge Wuhou, was struck speechless.

hunks.baseline: But the shock they felt did not end there.
hunks.sol: But that was not the end of their shock.

hunks.baseline: The enormous monster’s roar drove back the rain and burst the wind apart.
hunks.sol: The enormous monster’s roar drove back the rain and blasted apart the wind.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, a chilling aura spreading outward from the monster engulfed the entire bodies of the three people standing more than a hundred *jang* away.
hunks.sol: At the same time, a chilling aura spread outward from the monster and swept over all three men standing more than a hundred *jang* away.

hunks.baseline: The three figures stiffened at once, as if they had made an agreement to do so. In their three pairs of eyes, widened without their consent, unmistakable shock appeared.
hunks.sol: The three figures stiffened as one. Their eyes widened involuntarily, all three pairs filled with unmistakable shock.

hunks.baseline: *This can’t be!*
hunks.sol: *How can this be!*

hunks.baseline: Their bodies had grown heavy as wet cotton, and their clenched hands were tightening on their own.
hunks.sol: Their bodies felt as heavy as waterlogged cotton, and their hands clenched on their own.

hunks.baseline: Zhuge Feng, who still remained at the Peak realm, let out a faint groan amid an overpowering chill. Jeok Cheongang and Mungyeong, whose realms were unimaginably higher, swallowed a startled breath in spite of themselves.
hunks.sol: Zhuge Feng, who still remained at the Peak realm, let out a faint groan as a tremendous chill ran through him. Even Jeok Cheongang and Mungyeong, who stood in realms far beyond his, caught their breath in surprise.

hunks.baseline: The two extraordinary martial artists known as the Fire King and the Slaughter Saint immediately realized the identity of the unfamiliar sensation that had come over them.
hunks.sol: The two extraordinary martial artists known as the Fire King and the Slaughter Saint immediately recognized the unfamiliar sensation that had seized them.

hunks.baseline: It was an emotion they had forgotten long ago. A stale, ancient emotion they had been unable to feel since becoming beings so powerful that no one dared approach them.
hunks.sol: It was an emotion they had forgotten long ago. An ancient, long-buried feeling they had not experienced since becoming masters no one dared challenge.

hunks.baseline: The sheer strength of the Fear radiating from the Mutated Water God Dragon was certainly partly responsible. But the greater cause was the ignorance of Jeok Cheongang and Mungyeong.
hunks.sol: The overwhelming power of the Fear radiating from the Mutated Water God Dragon was partly responsible, but the greater cause was Jeok Cheongang and Mungyeong’s ignorance.

hunks.baseline: Their martial arts were unquestionably several levels above those of modern S-rank Hunters. Even so, the appearance of a gigantic monster they had never encountered before was more than enough to shake the firm minds of two people who had spent decades building their own domains and common sense.
hunks.sol: Their martial arts were unquestionably several levels above those of modern S-rank Hunters. Even so, the sudden appearance of a gigantic monster unlike anything they had ever encountered was more than enough to shake the iron minds of two men who had spent decades establishing their own understanding of the world.

hunks.baseline: The monster did not miss the opening and began rampaging with all its might.
hunks.sol: The monster did not miss the opening. It rampaged without restraint.

hunks.baseline: Each time its body, covered in black scales, lashed against the cliff, enormous bizarre boulders filled the sky before crashing down.
hunks.sol: Each time its black-scaled body slammed against the cliff, enormous jagged boulders filled the sky before crashing down.

hunks.baseline: A rain of bizarre boulders shot without pause toward somewhere hidden from view by the terrain.
hunks.sol: A ceaseless rain of boulders hurtled toward somewhere hidden from view by the terrain.

hunks.baseline: Flames poured from Jeok Cheongang’s eyes as he watched the sight.
hunks.sol: Flames blazed in Jeok Cheongang’s eyes as he watched.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang already knew what the unknown monster was attacking so relentlessly.
hunks.sol: He already knew what the unknown monster was attacking so relentlessly.

hunks.baseline: “Ha!”

hunks.baseline: If modern Hunters had witnessed the scene, they would have doubted their own eyes.

hunks.baseline: But Jeok Cheongang was not the only one to accomplish something so astonishing.
hunks.sol: But Jeok Cheongang was not the only one to accomplish such an astonishing feat.

hunks.baseline: If Jeok Cheongang dispelled part of Fear through his rage, Mungyeong overcame its oppression through cool reason and enlightenment half a step above Jeok Cheongang’s.
hunks.sol: While Jeok Cheongang dispelled part of the Fear through rage, Mungyeong overcame its oppression with cold reason and enlightenment half a step higher than Jeok Cheongang’s.

hunks.baseline: *An evil beast unheard of throughout history. It must be brought down here and now.*
hunks.sol: *An evil beast unheard of in all of history. It must be brought down here and now.*

hunks.baseline: The young medical apprentice who had always cared warmly for the sick was no longer present.
hunks.sol: The young medical apprentice who always tended warmly to the sick was no longer there.

hunks.baseline: As the greatest assassin of all time—the one feared by everyone in the world—took a step forward with calm eyes, his slender figure scattered like an illusion.
hunks.sol: The greatest assassin of all time, feared by everyone beneath the heavens, stepped forward with calm eyes. His slender figure scattered like an illusion.

hunks.baseline: The Slaughter Saint’s signature martial art, the Ghost Illusory Slaughter Step, shot forward after pressing down on the current and stepping across the raindrops.
hunks.sol: The Slaughter Saint’s signature martial art, the Ghost Illusory Slaughter Step, shot forward, pressing down the current and treading upon the raindrops.

hunks.baseline: His figure advanced like a streak of light, leaving behind only a pale afterimage. Beneath him, a single trail of flame raced forward, evaporating every trace of moisture around it.
hunks.sol: His figure streaked ahead like a beam of light, leaving only a pale afterimage behind. Beneath him, a single trail of flame raced forward, evaporating every trace of moisture around it.

hunks.baseline: A furious roar erupted from between Jeok Cheongang’s lips.
hunks.sol: A furious roar erupted from Jeok Cheongang’s lips.

hunks.baseline: “You unholy eel bastard! Get away from that boy this instant!”
hunks.sol: “You heaven-cursed eel bastard! Get away from that boy this instant!”

hunks.sol: A sharp, ringing shout pierced the ceaseless thunder as two figures charged toward the gigantic Water God Dragon like bolts of lightning.

hunks.baseline: *It might have been difficult alone, but things are different now.*
hunks.sol: *It might have been tough on my own, but this changes everything.*
